summary: Major restructure verified end-to-end via Expo web preview at 375x667. All 5 roles (individual, org, volunteer, ngo, requester) navigate from role-select to /(tabs)/home with correct role-specific home content. Bottom tab bar shows exactly 3 tabs (Home, Activity [role-labelled], Profile) with NO Impact tab for every role. Role-specific home actions match spec: individual=Donate Food; org=Bulk Donation + Quick Donation; volunteer=Volunteer Delivery; ngo=Incoming Donations; requester=Request Food. 'Your day' (volunteer), 'Today at your NGO' (ngo) and 'Your active request' (requester) stats cards render correctly above hero. Impact opens as a transparent modal sheet (85% height) with drag handle, back arrow + 'Back' text top-left, dark backdrop, hero meals card, weekly bar chart and 5 stat cards. Back button closes modal and returns to home. Volunteer Activity tab lists 4 task cards (t1-t4) with advance button working. Language toggle from EN->AR re-renders (verified English 'Your day' returns after toggle-back).

issues: Could not text-locate Arabic 'يومك' after EN->AR toggle while volunteer; toggle itself works (English 'Your day' returns on toggle-back). May be a substring locator / unicode issue rather than a real bug but worth visual verification of AR volunteer stats title.

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking console warnings: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated (use boxShadow), 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated', and 'useNativeDriver is not supported' on web (Animated falls back to JS). Consider suppressing or migrating styles for cleaner logs.

action_items: Optionally verify Arabic label 'يومك' visually renders on volunteer home after language toggle (locator test returned 0 matches; EN->AR->EN cycle otherwise works).
Optional polish: migrate deprecated RN web shadow* props to boxShadow and replace pointerEvents prop usage to silence console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: app/_layout.tsx declares 'impact' with presentation='transparentModal' + animation='fade'. Combined with the custom Animated slide inside impact.tsx this works but stacks two animations; acceptable for prototype.
activity.tsx default branch (donors) uses MOCK_MY_DONATIONS for both individual and org — fine, but org donations may eventually diverge; flag for future.
Tabs layout: activityLabel hardcodes 'My Requests' / 'My Donations' (English); would be better through t() keys for full AR localization of tab titles.
home.tsx hero uses useNativeDriver: false already — good for web.
